# Big Mac®

580 Cal.580 Cal.


# Big Mac®

580 Cal.580 Cal.

When a craving hits for those two all-beef patties it’s time to stop thinking about what’s on a Big Mac® and take a bite. The McDonald's Big Mac is a 100% beef burger with a taste like no other. The mouthwatering perfection starts with two [100% pure all beef patties](https://www.mcdonalds.com/us/en-us/faq/burgers.html) and Big Mac Sauce sandwiched between a sesame seed bun. It’s topped off with pickles, crisp shredded lettuce, finely chopped onion and a slice of American cheese. It contains no artificial flavors, preservatives or added colors from artificial sources. McDonald’s pickles contain an artificial preservative, so skip it if you like.

There are 580 calories in a Big Mac from McDonald's. Pair it with a [beverage](https://www.mcdonalds.com/us/en-us/full-menu/drinks.html) or get a [Big Mac Meal](https://www.mcdonalds.com/us/en-us/meal/big-mac-meal.html) with World Famous Fries® and Coca-Cola® or any of your favorite fountain drinks. Order a Big Mac today from the [full menu in the app](https://mcdonalds.smart.link/l7b1s5n3u?site_id=pdp&creative_id=text-publication) using Mobile Order & Pay for pickup or McDelivery®\* and earn points on eligible orders with [MyMcDonald's Rewards](https://www.mcdonalds.com/us/en-us/mymcdonalds.html) to redeem for a free Big Mac.^

©2026 The Coca-Cola Company. “Coca-Cola” is a registered trademark of The Coca-Cola Company.

\*At participating McDonald’s. McDelivery prices may be higher than at restaurants. Delivery/other fees may apply.

^Program available at participating McDonald’s. Must opt in to Rewards.
